alloy.preparation: As-cast AlxCoCrFeNi C-0 prepared at nominal molar ratio x = 0 using a vacuum arc remelter. Test specimens cut to 0.8 × 0.8 × 0.3 cm and cold mounted in epoxy, exposing a 0.8 × 0.8 cm surface; ground/polished with silicon-carbide paper, rinsed and dried. The separate SEM preparation to 0.05 µm alumina is not imposed as the electrode finish.

test_solution.preparation: Deaeration simultaneously provided by nitrogen gas flowing at 120 ml/min in the test solution; no duration stated.

test_method.procedure_description: Three-electrode cell with specimen working, Pt auxiliary and commercial Ag/AgCl reference in 3 M KCl; CH Instrument Model-600A. Cathodically polarized at −0.4 V SHE for 300 s to remove oxides; OCP quasi-steady-state time 900 s; scan from −0.6 to 1.4 V SHE. Figure 9 specifies 25 °C for the chloride series. Tests performed at least three times. The separate EIS perturbation and multi-day immersion tests do not define this polarization outcome.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Authors’ Epit bars in Figure 10; no fixed numerical current threshold is stated. Chloride-free high-potential response is described as transpassive; C-0 passive-layer deterioration is attributed to oxygen evolution, so its Epit label does not establish a pitting onset.

experiments.result_note: Approximate manual reading of the bar explicitly labeled Epit by the authors. Section 3.4 attributes deterioration of the C-0 passive layer to oxygen evolution rather than the pitting process; the reported Epit label is preserved with that qualification. The chloride-free polarization results are also described as transpassive in Section 3.2; this author-labeled Epit bar is not independently established here as a pitting onset. Bulk composition uses Table 1 wt.% entries. Table 6 before/after-immersion and phase-specific at% analyses are not substituted, and no composition basis conversion is performed.
